tour.title: Project Overview & Governance
tour.description: Start with the README and the operator/governance bibles that every bot reads at session start — they define the platform, the lane model, and the read-only lockdown rules.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point
tour.description: app.py is the FastAPI application — it mounts the D0/D1/D2 surfaces and exposes the storefront, terminal, webhook, and metrics endpoints.

tour.title: Upstream Source Clients
tour.description: Read-only clients ingest market data from each listing source. By construction they are GET-only (ALLOWED_HTTP_METHODS + _assert_readonly_method), so price/inventory can never be mutated.

tour.title: The Data Model
tour.description: The Supabase Postgres schema is built up through hundreds of timestamped migrations — starting from the init migration that defines events, snapshots, and watchlists.

tour.title: Edge Functions
tour.description: Deno/TypeScript edge functions handle cron auth, mail drains, seller webhooks, and chat — the serverless glue around the database.

tour.title: D0 Terminal Frontend
tour.description: The trader-facing terminal: discovery, event, and performer views that visualize the ingested market intelligence.

tour.title: D1 Storefront
tour.description: The consumer retail storefront surfaces (discover/event/about) plus its test sandbox.

tour.title: D4 Ticket Bridge
tour.description: The consumer claim/transfer/wallet-pass app — React/TypeScript source in d4_bridge, shipped as built bundles under static/bridge.

tour.title: D2 Orders Dashboard
tour.description: The orders dashboard service tracking fulfillment and metrics.

tour.title: CI/CD & Deploy
tour.description: GitHub Actions enforce docs-registry, forbidden-paths, read-only guards, and tests; Render manifests describe the deployed services.

tour.title: Tests & Read-Only Guards
